action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolphin makes two Dazzling Slam attacks.

action.name: Dazzling Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition blinded} until the start of the dolphin's next turn.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The dolphin can hold its breath for 20 minutes.
